title: Materi + Skills — the tenant's materi library, its prompt library, and their permalinks
description: Two libraries and one permalink shape, because a SKILL IS A MATERI (DECISIONS #36/#37 + `lessons.kind`): teaching material is TENANT-level content with its own canonical, shareable URL, and a course is just one ordered arrangement of it. /k/<t>/materi browses kind "materi"; /k/<t>/skills browses kind "skill" — rows that carry a `promptText`. Both are member-gated, cursor-paginated, tag-filtered iOS inset grouped lists with a three-way SORT (terbaru · terlama · A→Z; A→Z is in-page, stated not faked). The materi library narrows the LOADED pages client-side; the skills library gets a real server search over TITLE OR PROMPT TEXT (skills:searchSkills, debounced, top 20 of a bounded scan), because a prompt catalogue is unbrowsable without one. Both permalinks server-render the etalase header + generateMetadata + opengraph-image from publicGetBySlug and gate the body; a SKILL page puts the PROMPT PANEL (monospace, Salin-and-confirm) above that body, member-only — `promptText` is not on the anonymous projection at all. The two kinds share ONE slug namespace, so each permalink redirects a wrong-kind slug to the canonical route for the row's real kind instead of 404ing. The frontend only READS: materi/skill writes live in the Kelola console (features/courses lessons.*) and tags in features/materi/tags.

peers.reason: MarkdownView + YoutubeEmbed + LessonLinks — the app's one safe-subset markdown/embed pair; the in-course reader renders the same materi through the same components
useMyMembership drives the member gate on both surfaces
useDebouncedValue — the skills search box debounces exactly like the global /cari box; one 10-line hook, imported through the barrel rather than copied

app-shell: /k/[slug]/materi/[lessonSlug] ← server etalase header (<MateriPageHeader/>) + generateMetadata + opengraph-image (publicGetBySlug) + <MateriDetailView tenantId tenantSlug lessonSlug hasServerHeading gate />; redirects a kind:"skill" slug to /skills/<slug>
/k/[slug]/skills/[lessonSlug] ← the same server header + <MateriDetailView kind="skill" … />; redirects a kind:"materi" slug to /materi/<slug>
